title: $Rg_*$ has a right adjoint for proper $g$
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category and $g\colon Z\to Y$ a proper morphism.
Then the derived pushforward

$$
Rg_*=R(g_*)\colon D(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)
$$

(the right derived functor [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] of the pushforward of
[def-sfb-finite-lower-star]) has a right adjoint, denoted $Rg^!$.

proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: the unconditional ambient pro-etale exceptional adjoint is false. For a positive dimensional abelian variety E over an algebraically closed field and field coefficients, ProEtale.not_preservesColimitsOfShape_rightDerivedLowerStar_of_isAbelianVariety proves that derived pushforward fails to preserve countable coproducts. A left adjoint would preserve them. C9 independently compiled the negation of the exact instance conclusion, and separately checked IsProper E.hom; the negation uses only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The sandbox report contains the complete checked proof. The current adopted source again lacks the dispute marker recorded in the earlier G9 report; this delivery restores that marker without changing the signature, proof body, attributes, or imports. No upstream-statement exception permits correction or removal. The original hole remains: this is a disputed-statement delivery, with no proof, decomposition, or pruning claimed. The unit route is unchanged, and the active constructible exceptional functor is unaffected.
